messages:
Diego H: Hi finance, a Staples charge popped on my corporate card for $412.10 but I didn't make this purchase. Descriptor shows "STAPLES INC #1482" and vendor invoice #INV-9921. Can we reassign?
Nina S: Is it possible the Ops team ordered on your card by mistake? Diego, do you have the receipt or a packing slip?
Diego H: No receipt on my side. Card portal only shows merchant descriptor and invoice number. I checked with my team and nobody authorized it.
Sam T: Please open a ticket with the vendor and attach a note in the expense app. Finance needs either a vendor invoice matching your name or a reallocation request from the owner department. If vendor confirms charge was for "Ravi P" then we can request a G/L transfer.
Diego H: I messaged Staples support asking for merchant invoice PDF (chat ref 5541). Also DM'd Ops to check purchase records.
Ravi P: Confirmed Ops placed an order for monitors last week but used a blanket card. Ops says they billed it to "Engineering capital" and will send PO + approval.
Sam T: OK — next steps: 1) Diego, mark the transaction with tag "misassigned" in the expense app so it's not auto-cleared; 2) Ops (Ravi) please upload PO and approval email to Finance with reference INV-9921; 3) Finance will create internal reallocation and update GL once docs received.
Expenses Bot: Reminder: upload vendor invoice/PO and assign cost center; missing docs will hold payment reconciliation.
Diego H: Tagged transaction and added a short note. Thanks all.
Sam T: We'll pick this up in today's batch reconciliation and loop back when reallocation is complete.
